name: normalize
definition: Transform heterogeneous data, scores, units, labels, or state fields into a shared scale or canonical representation while preserving provenance and reversibility constraints.
operator_form: raw_values + scale_contract + provenance_record -> normalization_operation -> normalized_values + normalization_metadata + loss_report
acceptance_gates: No normalization without declaring the target scale.
No irreversible transform without loss report.
No normalized metric promoted as physical measurement unless independently validated.
failure_modes: Different units are mixed as if equivalent.
Scores are scaled without preserving source meaning.
Normalized proxy is treated as ground truth.
next_target: Bind raw_gate_scores -> shared 0..1 scale plus provenance plus loss report -> benchmark-ready metric set.
evidence_policy: Remain S0_REPO_FACT plus S5_PROXY until validation commands run and evidence is persisted.
